offering_description.value: Leases portable offices, storage containers and modular buildings to businesses, contractors and government bodies. It also delivers, sets up and services the units and sells related add-on products such as furniture, steps and security. Units come from its own fleet, built or sourced and maintained at branches.

primary_products.value: modular office units; portable storage containers; modular buildings; furniture and accessories; used unit sales

primary_services.value: equipment leasing; delivery and installation; unit maintenance and servicing; damage waiver and insurance; pickup and removal

customer_segment.value: B2B: construction firms, retailers, industrial companies, healthcare and education institutions, commercial users; B2G: government agencies and public school districts

end_markets.value: commercial construction; education; retail; healthcare; government; energy and natural resources; manufacturing

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: recurring monthly rent on modular space and storage units; service fees: delivery, installation, pickup, maintenance and value-added products and services; product sales: sales of new and used units
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and leases fleet of modular units and containers to businesses and government customers; service provider: delivers, installs and services units at customer sites

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: modular space and portable storage rental with related delivery and value-added products

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams and national accounts; own locations: network of branches and storage yards; online: website quoting and ordering

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, zoning and permitting for modular buildings, transport rules and environmental regulations
